fact: Loi n14-029/AU, adopted by the Assemblee de l'Union des Comores on 26 June 2014, institutes the Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertes (art. 19), whose nine members are named by decree (art. 24).
title: Loi portant protection des donnees a caractere personnel
publisher: Union des Comores, Ministere de la Justice
